programme_name: Independent AusTraits replication of temporal phylogenetic memory context

relationship_to_bien.rule: Do not tune AusTraits thresholds, trait mappings, or hypotheses to reproduce BIEN effect estimates.

replication_questions: Does trait identity robustly improve held-out-family prediction of phylogenetic memory in AusTraits?
After trait-specific means are controlled, is there repeatable family context across traits in AusTraits?

trait_mapping.primary_rule: Use AusTraits trait_name values only if they can be mapped one-to-one to a BIEN discovery trait by a frozen semantic dictionary before any AusTraits memory effect is opened.

temporal_eligibility.continuous: finite numeric value; one normalized unit per mapped trait; species state median
temporal_eligibility.categorical: unique modal category; tied species excluded

geometry_informativeness.rule: Reuse the same known-truth temporal geometry gate as BIEN; source-native family x trait geometries are independently evaluated.

trait_portability.statistic: leave-one-family-out same-trait predictor gain relative to global training mean
trait_portability.pass: gain > 0 and one-sided blocked-permutation p <= 0.05 on both S3 and prune-only

conditional_family_repeatability.report: estimate and 95% interval; compare descriptively with BIEN 0.10 practical reference but do not require matching magnitude

replication_interpretation.concordant: AusTraits also fails trait portability while retaining a positive estimated conditional family component with bootstrap lower bound >0.
replication_interpretation.partial: Only one of the two qualitative BIEN patterns replicates.
replication_interpretation.discordant: Trait portability is positive/robust or conditional family component is not estimable/compatible with zero.
replication_interpretation.rule: Report source-specific result; do not pool BIEN and AusTraits unless a later separately frozen synthesis is justified.
